caption_draft:
Six free tools to study for end-sems, with the official links.

Gemini Notebook — https://notebook.google/ — Free with a Gmail account
Anki — https://apps.ankiweb.net/ — Free on computer and Android
Obsidian — https://obsidian.md/ — Free, and works offline
Excalidraw — https://excalidraw.com/ — Free, no sign-up needed
Notion — https://www.notion.com/ — Free plan for individuals
Open Library — https://openlibrary.org/ — Borrow 10 books at once, free

Save this for exam week and pick one tool tonight. Send it to a friend who is studying for end-sems.

#studytips #endsem #engineeringstudents #firstyear #notes #productivity #btech #notyourcollege
